profile_text.body:
Broadcom Inc. is a public company headquartered in Palo Alto, California, traded under the ticker AVGO and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001730168. On its own site the company describes itself as delivering semiconductors and infrastructure software for global enterprises' most complex, mission-critical needs, under the tagline "Connecting Everything."

The site text names no individual products or AI-specific offerings. The company's legal exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281.
